vh-5-0-1-3.title: The Frost-Bitten Culvert
vh-5-0-1-3.text: Across a sunken frost-cracked stone wall, your old glacier scar throbs with a familiar, deep-seated ache against the cold, guiding your eye straight to a dry mossy culvert that neatly bypasses the muddy, churned-up cattle track. You adjust the heavy cradle of the bronze clapper on your aching back, feeling its faint, sympathetic hum vibrate through your shoulders as you weigh the damp path ahead against the bitter memory of the ice-fields above.
exits: Follow the mossy stone wall past the milestone
Duck beneath the frost-heavy arbor of dormant vines
Step past the toll-keeper into the shortcut

vh-5-0-1-4.title: The Hempen Guide-Line
vh-5-0-1-4.text: In a silent orchard lane thick as sheep's wool, you follow a length of hempen bell-rope tied tightly to fence posts to avoid stumbling blindly into the deep irrigation ditch. The dense mist muffles every sound save for the rhythmic dripping of moisture from unseen branches and the steady, low thrum of the bronze clapper against your padded shoulder framework.
exits: Climb out of the rotting drainage ditch
Pause beside the rune-carved mountain milestone
Take the quiet orchard shortcut without paying toll

vh-5-0-1-5.title: The Cider Shed
vh-5-0-1-5.text: Beneath a leaning cider shed smelling powerfully of vinegar and damp wood, you dodge a falling frost-heavy bough that shatters the wet gravel right at your heel. The shock of the near miss sends a shiver through your ribs, though the heavy bronze tongue in its cradle remains stubbornly cold and silent save for its deep, baseline vibration.
exits: Bypass the toll-keeper through the neglected shortcut
Push deeper into the grey fog-shrouded clearing

vh-5-0-1-7.title: The Wicker Hurdle
vh-5-0-1-7.text: Within a hollow ring of ancient pear trees, you find an abandoned wicker hurdle and strap it securely over your heavy bronze clapper to keep the persistent damp off the metal. The rough twigs scrape against your fingers as you knot the twine, listening closely to the muffled, bronze murmur that answers from beneath the weave.
exits: Trudge toward the frozen sheep-dip in the slush
Rest your burden inside the stone fruit-store
Inspect the broken wicker gate half-buried in leaves

vh-5-0-1-8.title: The White Labyrinth
vh-5-0-1-8.text: Under a dense grey ceiling of low cloud, you trace the frayed edge of a warden's guide-rope that leads deeper into the white blind labyrinth of the lower orchards. Every footstep is a guess against the swallowing fog, yet the steady hum of the long metal tongue against your back gives you a fixed point in the drifting grey world.
exits: Untangle the snagged guide-wire under the trellis
Seek shelter within the stone fruit-store
Check the broken wicker gate in the hedge
